title: PhD in Computer Science and Engineering
institution: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU), College of Science and Engineering
about: PhD in Computer Science and Engineering at Hamad Bin Khalifa University, Qatar, a 3.5-year programme per the 2026-27 prospectus. For the 2026-2027 admissions cycle, the deadline for international applicants is 1 February 2027.
requirements: Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical and electronic engineering, information systems, mathematics or a related field
Personal statement, transcripts and two recommendation letters (one academic)
Up to two applications per academic year

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Research" (record skill) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Personal statement, transcripts and two recommendation letters (one academic)" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
